original_ai_output.title_zh: 刚果（金）埃博拉疫情加剧心理健康危机，污名与冲突交织
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 刚果（金）东部埃博拉疫情持续蔓延，医护人员警告称，患者、幸存者及家属正承受不易察觉的心理健康危机。在布尼亚一处心理健康治疗中心，一名失去多名亲属的女性正在接受支持，她表示恐惧与污名让她感到孤立。世界卫生组织警告称，此次疫情可能超过十多年前西非最致命的埃博拉疫情，当时造成超过1.1万人死亡。

location.raw_text: Bunia, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo

key_facts.fact: 刚果（金）东部埃博拉疫情持续蔓延，并引发心理健康危机
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: As Ebola continues to devastate eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, health workers are warning of a less visible crisis: the psychological toll on patients, survivors and families left behind.

key_facts.fact: 布尼亚一名女性在失去多名亲属后于心理健康治疗中心接受支持
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: At a mental health treatment centre in Bunia, one woman is receiving support after losing two close relatives and three members of her extended family to the disease.

key_facts.fact: 世界卫生组织警告称此次疫情可能超过西非最致命的埃博拉疫情，后者造成超过1.1万人死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The World Health Organization has warned that it could surpass the deadliest Ebola outbreak in history, which erupted more than a decade ago and killed more than 11,000 people in West Africa.

uncertainties: 疫情最终规模尚不确定，世卫组织仅警告可能超过历史最严重疫情
目前仅单一来源（Africanews）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
